items.heading: Nasi Goreng
details: Key ingredients: cooked rice, sweet soy sauce, shallots, garlic, chili, egg
Stir-fry shallots, garlic and chili paste until fragrant.
Add day-old rice and toss well with sweet soy sauce.
Push rice aside and scramble an egg directly in the pan.
Mix through and serve topped with a fried egg and crackers.

items.heading: Chicken Satay
details: Key ingredients: chicken, turmeric, coriander, peanut sauce, skewers
Marinate chicken pieces in a turmeric and coriander spice paste.
Thread onto skewers and grill over hot coals until charred.
Prepare a rich peanut sauce with chili and a touch of sweetness.
Serve the skewers with the peanut sauce and rice cakes.

items.heading: Beef Rendang
details: Key ingredients: beef, coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, dried chilies, kaffir lime
Blend a spice paste from chilies, lemongrass, galangal and shallots.
Fry the paste until fragrant, then add beef chunks.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer slowly for hours, stirring occasionally.
Cook until the liquid reduces into a thick, dark, richly spiced coating.
